senses.gloss: f. (Dan. IV, 16; preced., v. Del. Proleg. p. 39 sq.) moment, while; hour, esp. the twelfth portion of the day and of the night, varying according to the season.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 1:1">Tosef. Ber. I, 1</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="P00297"><he>עוֹנָה</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 7a:10">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00218"><he>רֶגַע</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 7b:22">Ib. 7ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>הש׳ משחקת</he>, v. <cite ref="U00695"><he>שָׂחַק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:13">Lam. R. to III, 37</cite> <he>מש׳ שאמר וכ׳</he> from the moment that the Lord said &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ber. I, 1</cite> <he>מש׳ שהכהנים וכ׳</he> from the time of day when the priests go in &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 2:1">Pes. II, 1</cite> <he>כל ש׳</he> as long.
<cite ref="Ketubot 104a:8">Keth. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>בש׳ שהצדיק וכ׳</he> when a righteous man is called away &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 104a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>בשְׁעַת פטירתו וכ׳</he> when Rabbi died &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 64a:2">Ber. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>הדוחק את הש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D00434"><he>דָּחַק</he></cite>; <he>נדחה מפני הש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D00397"><he>דָּחָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 10a:7">Sabb. 10ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מניחין … ועוסקין בחיי ש׳</he> they neglect the life everlasting, and busy themselves with the life of the hour (earthly affairs).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:11:5">Y. Taan. III, 67ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>יולדתך</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 23:25">Prov. XXIII, 25</cite>) <he>שַׁעַתְךָ</he> (or <he>שַׁעְתְּךָ</he>) thy hour (of birth).

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:9">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite>, a. e. <he>בשַׁעְתּוֹ</he> in its due time, v. <cite ref="O01381"><he>סֵפֶל</he></cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:4">Num. R. s. 10<sup>4</sup></cite> <he>בין שעתו</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 19:4">Ex. R. s. 19</cite>, a. fr. <he>לש׳ קלה</he>, v. <cite ref="S01230"><he>קַל</he> II</cite>; a. v. fr.—<he>הוראת ש׳</he>, or <he>ש׳</he> temporary, special legislation, opp. <he>דורות</he>.
<cite ref="Yoma 69b:5">Yoma 69ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Menachot 19b:5">Men. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>דורות מש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D00345"><he>דּוֹר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Menachot 56a:4">Ib. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ מדורות וכ׳</he> we cannot derive the modes of a temporary act (e.g. the offerings of the princes, <cite ref="Numbers 7:12-83">Num. VII, 12-83</cite>) from the laws concerning a permanent institution; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="U01645"><he>שָׁעוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 3a:5">Ber. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>עד ארבע ש׳</he> to four hours (the fourth hour of the night).
<cite ref="Pesachim 58a:3">Pes. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>שתי ש׳ ומחצה</he> two hours and a half.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 5:3">Snh. V, 3</cite> <he>אחד אומר בשתי ש׳ וכ׳</he> if one witness testifies that the act under consideration was committed at the second hour of the day &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:4">Kel. XII, 4</cite> <he>אבן הש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A00172"><he>אֶבֶן</he></cite>; a. v. fr.
